prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1196; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The same service was billed twice for the same date, and the provider admitted the second charge was a repeat.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked and the left taillight assembly is broken, with scuffing along the left quarter panel that matches the low-speed impact described by the vehicle owner. The damage pattern lines up well with the reported contact, and no prior damage to the vehicle is known from our records. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and taillight, refinishing the quarter panel, and a short round of blending paint. The labor hours listed fit the scope of this work. A note on the file: the same service appears twice under one date, and the provider has acknowledged the second entry was a repeat, so that line should be removed before the estimate is finalized.
